scope: documentation and disposition ledger only; no normify binary change, no module tree change, no product code

rule.span_definition: max over module.source of ((s.end_line or s.line) - s.line); 0 when no line/end_line recorded
rule.warning_kind: single aggregate warning: 'W structure/leaf-too-coarse <N> ...'; N is a count, not a line count
rule.misreading: the '220' applies to recorded line ranges, not to file length

measured.method: materials/measured-coarse.txt (read-only recomputation, cross-checked with normify validate)

warning_text_mismatch: warning says 'multi-file or over 220 lines' but the 220 branch measures recorded line ranges (currently never fires) and 16 single-source leaves over 220 LF are not counted

options_not_implemented.A: fix the warning wording only (requires changing the shared normify binary; needs user approval)
options_not_implemented.B: make the span branch meaningful by measuring file length (changes rule semantics; needs user approval)

dispositions.qa_154_o2: note line-count convention in later evidence (LF vs Sigma(LF+1))
dispositions.qa_154_o3: note rpc-only API column convention in later evidence
dispositions.qa_154_o4: record-level accept; zero-source containers have no row
